statements.heading: Incident reporting
statements.text: Harbour Mutual Bank must notify the regulator of a major incident within 4 hours of classifying it, and no later than 24 hours after first detecting it.

statements.heading: Third-party contracts
statements.text: Contracts with material providers made before 1 January 2027 must meet paragraph 6.3 at their next renewal or by 31 December 2028, whichever is earlier.
